caption: Time runs down the page. Four solid arrows are calls and three dashed arrows are returns, seven arrows in all: the PIN check finishes before the withdrawal begins, and the cash comes out last.

spec.aria: Three lifelines for User, ATM and Bank: solid arrows carry the calls insert card, verify PIN, withdraw ₹2,000 and debit ₹2,000 downward in time, while three dashed arrows carry the PIN reply, the approval and the cash back, seven messages in all.
